title: Mix and match parts
body: Bodies, outfits, hair, hats and props share one skeleton, so any combination walks and turns the same way.

title: Anatomy sliders
body: Head size, limb length and build, from chibi to tall, while clothes and props follow.

title: Side view and top-down
body: A platformer side camera or an RPG 3/4 view, from the same character.

title: Shader graph editor
body: Outlines, toon bands, dither and palettes are nodes you can rewire.

title: Your own models
body: Load a GLB, glTF or VRM file. It stays on your machine and is never uploaded.

title: Sheets your engine can read
body: A PNG sheet, metadata JSON with frame rects, and a CREDITS.txt for every asset used.
